scope: KooshaPari/RepoLedger local checkout and public remote boundary

remote.description: pnpm monorepo for the repo-ledger ecosystem console

validation.evidence: tsc -b and Vite production build; 196 modules transformed

decision.rationale: Distinct governance-console boundary with UI and Go state backend. It can consume registry data but should not absorb registry source or managed runtime repositories.
decision.risk: No tracked license or README; licensing and operator documentation are required before treating it as distributable enterprise OSS.
decision.next_gate: Add an explicit license and canonical operator documentation in RepoLedger; then evaluate read-only registry API integration.

actions_taken: No source files, branches, worktrees, or remotes were deleted or reset.
No dirty local source required recovery preservation; checkout matched origin/main.
Ignored build and dependency outputs were not added to the registry record.
